fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix Inc. (SKHY) is the world's second-largest memory supplier with revenue composition of 60~70% DRAM and 30~35% NAND (as of 2025, 29% DRAM and 22% NAND market share).
fields.summary_ko.1: As a semiconductor memory manufacturer, it supplies DRAM and NAND flash products essential for high-performance computing and data storage.
